description: This Java class implements a manager for storing and retrieving product image files using Infinispan cache. It provides methods for adding, fetching, and removing product images, handling different image sizes, and managing cache nodes based on merchant store and product identifiers.

classes.name: CmsImageFileManagerInfinispanImpl
classes.description: A Java class managing product images in a cache using Infinispan, supporting add, retrieve, and delete operations, with cache node management based on merchant and product identifiers.

methods.name: stopFileManager
methods.description: Stops the cache manager, typically during servlet undeploy.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton pattern method to get the instance of the manager.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Adds a product image to the cache, organizing by merchant, product SKU, and image size.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a product image from the cache based on product details.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Fetches all images for a merchant store or product.

methods.name: removeImages
methods.description: Removes all images associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: removeProductImage
methods.description: Removes a specific product image from the cache.

methods.name: removeProductImages
methods.description: Removes all images for a specific product.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Fetches or creates a cache node based on a given path string.
